items.criterion: The measured report is reachable from the CLI entrypoint (auger.py spec assemble --measure) and the flag is registered/parsed, not dead code.
items.detail: --measure is registered on the assemble subparser at auger.py:14060-14067, read via `measure = bool(getattr(a, "measure", False))` at auger.py:12714, and consumed by the report branch at auger.py:12860. The live CLI invocation exited 0 and emitted the seven keys, proving the path is reachable end to end.

items.criterion: The default (unmeasured) JSON document keeps its exact prior key set, so AC-4 byte-reproducibility is not broken by the instrumentation.

items.criterion: --measure with a non-JSON format refuses with a typed error and non-zero exit instead of silently emitting an unmeasured document.
items.detail: `python3 auger.py spec assemble specs --applies-to auger.spec.select --format markdown --measure` -> `spec error (measure-requires-json): --measure reports a JSON object; pass --format json ...`, EXIT=2. Guard at auger.py:12715-12721, with a second refusal in render_spec_assembly at auger.py:9052-9057; pinned by the green test_measure_without_json_refuses.

items.criterion: The lazy indexed loader does not change behaviour of the other spec verbs (validate/check/bundle/list/render/context) — the existing spec suites stay green.
items.detail: Ran `python3 -m pytest tests/test_spec_assembly_report.py tests/test_xml_specs.py tests/test_spec_render.py tests/test_spec_context.py tests/test_spec_corpus_view.py tests/test_spec_validate_obligations.py tests/test_spec_obligation_gate.py tests/test_spec_decision_ref.py tests/test_spec_rollback.py tests/test_spec_alignment_check.py tests/test_spec_repository_root.py tests/test_xml_task_contract.py tests/test_verification_graph.py tests/test_spec_validators_agree.py -q` -> `215 passed in 20.08s`, exit 0. items.criterion: output_bytes equals the bytes actually written to --out (the seam between the measured value and the consumer's file).
items.detail: /tmp/aug140-eval.json is 3118 bytes on disk and its output_bytes field is 3118 (match True).
